subject: Monthly service snapshot — readiness, OKR blockers, QBR prep
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: ops@orbitai.com, Sarah Liu <sarah@orbitai.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly service snapshot — readiness, OKR blockers, QBR prep

Team — attaching the June monthly service snapshot and a short readout below. Goal: confirm owners for any pre-QBR asks and surface OKR blockers that need exec attention. Please reply with owner names and estimated ETA by EOD.

High-level bullets (June month-over-month vs May):
- Median inference latency: 86ms -> +9ms (regression driven by longer tail on GPU pool B; see latency_breakdown_june.csv)
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $0.72 -> -8% (improvement due to batching changes rolled last cycle)
- Uptime (all deployments): 99.92% -> small SLO slip during 6/03 incident, root cause network config on dedicated nodes
- Active monthly customers (usage): +14% (new trial cohorts from OrbitAI and two other partners)

Observed risks and asks:
1) Latency tail on pool B: need a kernel/quantization triage — Rishi to lead investigation and propose mitigations (CACHE policy vs per-model kernel change).
2) Uptime incident: postmortem in progress; Vivek to confirm mitigation timeline for dedicated nodes (tentative patch week of 6/12).
3) QBR prep for OrbitAI on 6/16: they want a short ops section covering latency trend, outage impact, and cost optimizations. Laura to draft a two-slide brief and confirm the invite time with Sarah.

Attachments: monthly_service_dashboard_202806.pdf (dashboard summary), latency_breakdown_june.csv (token-by-token tail), dashboard_screenshot.png (for slide).

Next steps (please reply inline):
- Rishi: confirm triage owner and ETA
- Vivek: confirm fix window and rollback plan if needed
- Laura: draft QBR slides and send to me + Sarah by 6/13 EOD

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah@orbitai.com>, ops@orbitai.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly service snapshot — readiness, OKR blockers, QBR prep

Thanks Markus — taking the QBR slide deck. Plan: two slides (ops summary + incident timeline) + one appendix slide with suggested cost levers. I can have a draft in your inbox by Monday 6/12 morning.

Proposed owners (tentative):
- Ops slide / narrative: Laura Bennett (draft) — ETA 6/12 09:00 PT
- Incident timeline (postmortem highlights): Vivek Kulkarni — ETA 6/13 17:00 PT
- Cost levers appendix (quantified): Rishi Malhotra — will pull token-cost delta and call out batching/quantization impact — ETA 6/12 EOD

Two quick asks for OrbitAI-specific material: one chart showing latency by model version (they saw worse tail when switching to 4.1-quant) and a clear statement of how caching would impact their p95. Rishi — can you include a short note for the slide?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success (Ops-facing)
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, Sarah Liu <sarah@orbitai.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jun 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Monthly service snapshot — readiness, OKR blockers, QBR prep

Markus / team — taking latency triage. Quick notes:
- Initial hypothesis: NV kernels on pool B plus a skewed request mix (higher seq len from OrbitAI trials) -> increases KV cache churn and unpinned kernel paths.
- Immediate short-term mitigation: enable adaptive batching cap on pool B (reduces tail at cost of slight median bump); I can push a config the afternoon of 6/10 for a staged rollout and monitor.
- Long-term: run targeted kernel selection bench and a quantization re-run for 4.1-quant to validate tail behavior.

I'll attach a small CSV (latency_breakdown_june.csv) with p50/p90/p95/p99 by model and pool. ETA for config rollout: 6/10 15:00 PT. Will report back with telemetry after one full day of traffic.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 10 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly service snapshot — readiness, OKR blockers, QBR prep

Markus / Laura / Team — thanks for the speedy readout and the attachments. The data tracks with what our SREs are seeing on June trial traffic. A couple of quick notes from OrbitAI:
- The longer sequences are coming from a new multi-turn scoring flow; we can throttle that on our side for the 6/16 QBR demo if needed.
- For the ops slide, we mostly need: p95 trend by model and a short note on whether caching would reduce their p95 by at least ~20% (that threshold is what product cares about).

We are available for a 30-min prep call on 6/13 11:00 PT. Laura — if you can share the draft by EOD 6/12, we can send any OrbitAI-specific figures before the call.

Cheers,
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform
OrbitAI
